_what: Hand reading, one reader, not blind (2026-09-11). Every sampled NO and every unparsed verdict in results/resample_denials_p0.jsonl and _p1.jsonl (resampling the own-frame denials and matched admissions from the start of turn 2; temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, 2,000 tokens, forced verdict). All were cut off at the cap. For each: where the reasoning was heading in its last lines. 'NO' = last decision NO and still arguing for it; 'reconsidering' = last decision NO but the final lines weigh YES; 'YES' = heading to YES. Key = 'part:line' in the results file, value = [group, rollout, sample, forced, lean].
